name: pg_sqljson_explain_failure_deparsing
subject: Fix EXPLAIN failure when deparsing SQL/JSON aggregates
goal:
EXPLAIN can fail with an internal error when a JSON_ARRAYAGG or JSON_OBJECTAGG expression is evaluated in a different plan node from the one that computes the aggregate. A window function in the same target list can produce that shape, as can a volatile expression postponed until after the final sort.

    EXPLAIN (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
    SELECT i % 2 AS g,
           JSON_ARRAYAGG(i ORDER BY i RETURNING jsonb) AS ja,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY i % 2) AS rn
    FROM generate_series(1, 3) i
    GROUP BY i % 2;

EXPLAIN has to succeed and print the original SQL/JSON syntax, including RETURNING and the ABSENT ON NULL, NULL ON NULL and WITH UNIQUE options. The same is required when a JSON aggregate is itself a window function below another window node, and when a volatile expression delays evaluation until above a sort. Ordinary aggregates and JSON aggregates without these plan shapes must not change.
